items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: my drummer Nikki, she’s my favorite drummer

ctx.x: Or the opposite, if you want to start your solo down and they’re like.
Exactly. Yeah, I’ve like, many, many times, if you’ve ever been to my shows, I’m always — my drummer Nikki, she’s my favorite drummer, but she’s always like —
I think I saw you at the Electric Company with her.
